catalogMeta.label: Solve Story (Scaffold 3)
catalogMeta.description: Solve a word problem and SAY the answer out loud. The unknown may be the result, the change, or the start (AXIS 2). Unaided spoken production at both grades — no numeral menu and no keyboard.

fullData.title: Playground Math Adventures

challenges.instruction: Listen to the story and count how many ducks are swimming now!
challenges.storyText: 3 ducks are swimming in the pond. 2 more ducks join them.

challenges.instruction: Help out on the farm! How many apples are there altogether?
challenges.storyText: 4 red apples are on the table. 3 green apples are put next to them.

challenges.instruction: Look at the playground! How many children are playing now?
challenges.storyText: 5 children are playing on the swings. 2 more children run over to play.

challenges.instruction: Time for a snack in the kitchen! How many cookies are left?
challenges.storyText: 6 cookies are on a plate. 2 cookies are eaten.

challenges.instruction: Out in the sunny garden! How many flowers are blooming in total?
challenges.storyText: 4 pink flowers and 4 yellow flowers grow in the garden bed.

challenges.instruction: Blast off into space! How many stars are shining now?
challenges.storyText: 5 bright stars are shining in the sky. 3 more stars appear.

challenges.instruction: Back by the pond! How many frogs are left on the log?
challenges.storyText: 7 frogs are resting on a big log. 3 frogs hop away into the water.

fullData.description: Engaging word problem challenges helping kindergarteners solve addition and subtraction situations within 10 using objects and equations.
